title: Reading narratives and comparing personal experiences

questions.prompt: In a narrative, which tense presents the setting? « Il ___ quand la porte s'est ouverte. »
questions.explanation: Pleuvait describes ongoing weather while the door-opening is bounded.

questions.prompt: Complete the completed action: « Soudain, Clara ___ son téléphone. »
questions.explanation: A perdu is a completed past event introduced by soudain.

questions.prompt: Choose the sequence: « Il ___ à la gare puis ___ le train. »
questions.explanation: Arriver takes être, while prendre uses avoir in the compound past.

questions.prompt: Complete a former routine: « Autrefois, nous ___ le dimanche chez nos cousins. »
questions.explanation: Déjeunions in the imperfect expresses a past habit.

questions.prompt: Which clause clearly marks an interruption?
choices: Je lirai quand le téléphone sonnait hier.
J'ai lu tous les soirs demain.
Je lisais quand le téléphone a sonné.
questions.explanation: Lisais is an ongoing background action; a sonné interrupts it.

questions.prompt: Complete the past description: « Les rues ___ calmes avant la fête. »
questions.explanation: Étaient describes a continuing condition in the past.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct completed departure for two girls:
choices: Elles sont parties à huit heures.
Elles ont parties à huit heures.
Elles sont partis à huit heures.
questions.explanation: Partir uses être and parties agrees with feminine plural elles.

questions.prompt: Which connector marks the next narrative event?
questions.explanation: Puis indicates a subsequent event in a sequence.

questions.prompt: Choose a correct past negative: « Nous ___ rien entendu. »
questions.explanation: N'avons rien entendu correctly negates entendre with avoir.

questions.prompt: Read: « À sept heures, Léa préparait son sac lorsque son père a appelé. » What was underway?
questions.explanation: Préparait describes the ongoing action at the moment of the call.

questions.prompt: Read: « Chaque hiver, Samir allait au village; en 2022, il est resté en ville. » What changed?
choices: He went to the village for the first time in 2022.
He moved permanently to the village.
He stayed in town during 2022 instead of taking his customary trip.
questions.explanation: Chaque hiver frames a habit; est resté introduces a particular exception.

questions.prompt: Read: « Le bus avait dix minutes de retard, alors nous avons marché. » Why did they walk?
questions.explanation: Alors links the ten-minute delay to their decision to walk.

questions.prompt: Read: « Zoé lisait un message, mais son frère écrivait une lettre. » Who wrote?
questions.explanation: Écrivait une lettre refers to son frère, whereas Zoé was reading.

questions.prompt: Read: « Il faisait nuit quand la lumière s'est allumée. » What changed at that moment?
questions.explanation: S'est allumée marks the light switching on.

questions.prompt: Read: « Nous avions faim, donc nous sommes entrés dans une boulangerie. » What motivated entry?
choices: They were looking for a library.
questions.explanation: Avions faim describes the state that explains entering a bakery.

questions.prompt: Read: « Elle n'a jamais oublié cette journée. » What does jamais mean here?
questions.explanation: Ne ... jamais means the remembering lapse did not occur.

questions.prompt: Read: « Après avoir perdu ses clés, Hugo a téléphoné à sa sœur. » Which happened first?
choices: Hugo called before the keys were lost.
questions.explanation: Après avoir perdu explicitly orders the loss before the phone call.

questions.prompt: Read: « La rue était vide, mais soudain un vélo est apparu. » What was unexpected?
choices: The bicycle had been there all morning.
A bicycle appeared on the empty street.
questions.explanation: Soudain introduces the sudden appearance against an empty-street background.

questions.prompt: A learner summarizes « Je marchais quand je suis tombé ». Which summary is accurate?
choices: The speaker was walking when a fall occurred.
The speaker fell every day while walking.
The speaker plans to fall tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Marchais indicates ongoing movement; suis tombé a completed fall.

questions.prompt: You write about a repeated childhood activity. Which is best?
choices: Samedi dernier, j'ai rendu visite à ma tante.
Samedi prochain, je rendrai visite à ma tante.
Tous les samedis, je rendais visite à ma tante.
questions.explanation: Tous les samedis plus imperfect expresses repetition.

questions.prompt: A story needs one completed event after background weather. Choose the best.
choices: Il a plu chaque demain quand nous partirons.
Il pleuvait quand nous avons quitté la maison.
Il pleuvra quand nous quittions hier.
questions.explanation: The imperfect provides background and avons quitté marks the event.

questions.prompt: A student writes « Elles ont arrivées hier ». Correct the narrative.
questions.explanation: Arriver forms the compound past with être, including feminine plural agreement.

questions.prompt: Two stories differ: one says « il attendait », the other « il a attendu vingt minutes ». What differs?
choices: The first is in the future; the second is present.
Both necessarily describe repeated weekly habits.
The first presents background; the second frames a bounded wait.
questions.explanation: Imperfect versus a bounded passé composé frame the waiting differently.

questions.prompt: You must connect a cause and a response. Which is coherent?
choices: Puisque le train annulera hier, nous avons taxis.
Comme le train était annulé, nous avons pris un taxi.
Le train sera annulé hier, donc nous prenions demain.
questions.explanation: The ongoing cancellation context explains the completed decision to take a taxi.

questions.prompt: A narrative says « Elle dormait lorsqu'un bruit l'a réveillée ». What is the second event?
questions.explanation: L'a réveillée is the completed interruption of dormait.

questions.prompt: You need to correct an invented detail in a source-based retelling. Which choice is best?
choices: Add colorful dialogue as if directly quoted.
Invent the traveler's motive to make the story exciting.
Keep only events supported by the source and label uncertainties.
questions.explanation: A source-based retelling must distinguish evidence from invented narrative.

questions.prompt: You compare two descriptions of a journey. Which question checks the timeline?
choices: Quel récit a le titre le plus court ?
Quels événements se produisent avant et après l'arrivée ?
Quelle police de caractères est la plus jolie ?
questions.explanation: Before-and-after event ordering tests comprehension of narrative chronology.
